On May 05, 1952, at 22:05 hours, TABA reported detecting something moving between radio ranges 120 and 270 from Anápolis. The object was estimated to be traveling at a speed of approximately 40 knots, heading west, with no altitude indication. Contact began at a range of 300 to 3 miles from Anápolis on radio 300 and ended at 266, 23 miles, with a brief loss of contact at 8 miles from AN (radio 250), lasting for approximately 30 minutes.

It was 25 kilometers away and traveling at a speed of 420 kt, with a radial of 2009. About 170 miles away, it suddenly changed direction, revealing a bright, large object. Our initial impression was of a UFO capturing (or following) an object that resembled a comet, as it had a glowing tail.
